instructions.question: Does the poster of this Serbian tweet express a positive feeling (warmth, joy, enthusiasm, pleasant wishes), a negative feeling (displeasure, sadness, sarcasm, mockery, self-put-down), or neither (neutral)?
instructions.rule: Judge the wording, not the topic. Positive needs explicitly positive words or warmth: praise, enthusiasm ('top', 'uživati' / enjoy, 'živeo' / long live), greetings with ;), laughter, compliments, or pleasant wishes and daydreams. Plain announcements of events or news stay neutral. Negative needs explicit displeasure, sadness, sarcastic praise, a mocking jab at people or their habits, or self-mockery admitting a failing (laziness, stupidity, ugliness). Puns, absurd anecdotes, banter, questions, aphorisms and earnest opinions are neutral; crime or scandal headlines are negative.

neutral.what: Plain information and announcements, plans, questions, banter, aphorisms, earnest opinions, puns and absurd anecdotes without a target or admitted failing.
examples: RT @ArtBoulevard: 15. Festival studentskog filma poziva zainteresovane (15th Student Film Festival invites those interested)
Igraš košarku za Zadar, prezivaš se Šutalo a nemaš neki šut - gle ironije. (You play for Zadar, your surname is Šutalo, and you can't shoot - irony.)
Gledacu serije. (I'll watch series.)
neutral.cues: jel (is it), kao (like), dates, link shares, wordplay, sayings
neutral.not_for: Enthusiastic wording is positive. Mockery, admitted failings and displeasure are negative.

positive.what: Explicit warmth, joy, praise, enthusiasm, laughter, greetings, compliments, pleasant wishes or daydreams, and promotions worded with enthusiasm.
examples: RT @Speranca: A od sutra u @UKParobrod Dani iranske kulture. Vidim biće mnogo dobrih filmova. (From tomorrow, Iranian Culture Days at Parobrod. There will be many good films.)
Pozdrav za @atjah sa kruševačke obilaznice ;) (Greetings to @atjah from the Kruševac bypass ;))
Da stavim trajnu sminku, da se budim prelepa kao u filmovima (To get permanent make-up and wake up gorgeous like in films)
positive.cues: sjajno (great), top, uživati (enjoy), sa zadovoljstvom (with pleasure), živeo (long live), do jaja (awesome), pozdrav (greetings), poprave raspoloženje (lift my mood), HAHAHA, ;)
positive.not_for: Mock praise is negative. Plain event or news announcements are neutral.

negative.what: Explicit displeasure, boredom, sadness, sarcastic praise, mocking people or their habits, self-mockery admitting a failing, and crime headlines.
examples: Moje pauze od ucenja traju duze nego samo ucenje (My study breaks last longer than the studying)
Zajednicki fejsbuk profili parova imaju smisla koliko i profili necijeg kera, fetusa ili tek rodjene bebe (Couples' shared Facebook profiles make as much sense as a dog's, a fetus's or a newborn's)
Mrzim ponedeljak (I hate Monday)
negative.cues: mrzim (I hate), najgore (the worst), dosadno (boring), debil (idiot), pametno trošim (I spend smartly, ironic), jebi ga (damn), :( , ubijen (killed)
negative.not_for: Puns and absurd exaggeration without a target are neutral.
